offer.title: Stage analyste sécurité
offer.job_text: Internship position in Geneva reserved for enrolled students with a required school agreement. The intern assists with Linux log review, Wireshark captures, basic Python scripts and reports on Nessus findings. The placement lasts six months and is not a permanent employment contract. Candidates who cannot provide a student agreement are not eligible even if they have relevant technical projects.
